content_sections.heading: IITI-SVV Junior Research Fellow Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 32 years as on 1 November 2026. It is relaxed by 5 years for SC, ST, OBC, Female and PH candidates. Post-graduation in Basic Sciences/Engineering/Pharmacy/Technology from a UGC recognized University/Institute/Autonomous bodies. 60% aggregate marks for GEN candidates and 55% aggregate marks for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PH candidates. CSIR/UGC-NET/SET or GATE/GPAT qualification. Prior experience in basic techniques applied in Advanced Material, Environmental Sustainability and Energy Technology, and Health and Medical Technologies. Applicants from the SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PH categories who hold a valid Madhya Pradesh domicile certificate will be given priority, if found suitable. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview, and only shortlisted candidates will be called. The interview schedule will be conveyed through the University website or by email. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The initial appointment runs up to 31 March 2027 and is likely to continue till the project ends. The project will be implemented at Indian Institute of Technology Indore in collaboration with Samrat Vikramaditya Vishwavidyalaya, Ujjain. The workplace may vary from time to time as per project requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IITI-SVV Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check the list of projects . Scan all relevant educational certificates properly into a single PDF file. Open the JRF application Google form and fill in the application in the prescribed format. Upload the PDF and submit the application by 10 November 2026. Incomplete applications will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. Is NET or GATE compulsory for this JRF post?
faq.answer: Yes. Along with post-graduation, candidates need a CSIR/UGC-NET/SET or GATE/GPAT qualification.

faq.question: Q2. What marks are required in post-graduation?
faq.answer: GEN candidates need 60% aggregate marks, while SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PH candidates need 55% aggregate marks.

faq.question: Q3. Who gets the age relaxation?
faq.answer: SC, ST, OBC, Female and PH candidates get a 5-year relaxation on the upper age limit of 32 years.

faq.question: Q4. How long will the fellowship last?
faq.answer: The first appointment is up to 31 March 2027, and it is likely to continue till the project ends.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be uploaded with the application?
faq.answer: All relevant educational certificates must be properly scanned into a single PDF file and submitted through the Google form.

faq.question: Q6. Will every applicant be interviewed?
faq.answer: No. Only shortlisted candidates will be called, and they will be told the schedule through the University website or by email.

faq.question: Q7. Is travel allowance paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected fellows work?
faq.answer: The project is implemented at IIT Indore in collaboration with Samrat Vikramaditya Vishwavidyalaya, Ujjain, and the workplace may vary from time to time as per project requirements.
